tools.name: about_agency_growth
tools.description: What Agency Growth (agencygrowth.com) does, who it is for, and how it can help. Use when the user asks about Agency Growth.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Agency Growth's plans, prices, and where each one starts. Use when the user asks about pricing or plans.

tools.name: run_ai_audit
tools.description: Run Agency Growth's free AI audit of the user's business. Ask the user for each field first; never guess or invent any of them, and only call this once the user has given their name and email and agreed to receive the result by email. Takes about a minute. Returns the three automations ranked by hou

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: run_ai_audit · Public sink: run_ai_audit · Destructive: run_ai_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: run_ai_audit · Public sink: run_ai_audit · Destructive: run_ai_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
